message: Invalid Context Range: 0, 228 must be in 0, 22
trigger: Tap Run synthetic CPU test; its JSON result was appended to the log TextView
root_cause: The read-only log installed ScrollingMovementMethod, which created Editor/Spannable interaction state, then mutated the same buffer with TextView.append(). On Android 16 hardware text drawing, an old 228-character run remained while the current draw buffer length was 22, producing the observed invalid context range.
fix: Remove ScrollingMovementMethod and append(); keep bounded immutable String state, post updates to the View, call setText with TextView.BufferType.NORMAL, disable text selection and state saving, and cap text at 16000 characters.
note: Find X8 temporary device validation != Xiaomi Pad final validation
